<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/sessions/{sessionId}/terminate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stops the session's VM but keeps its disk, so the session stays listed as terminated and can be restored later. Use only when you intend to restore the session; otherwise call DeleteSession, which works on running sessions too and frees the disk. Where the feature is enabled for the workspace, a caller holding the workspace's billing-view permission (workspace owners and billing-managing custom roles) may terminate any session of the workspace, including another member's; the usage report lists them. A personal access token is required for that: workspace and session tokens keep their own reach. The session returned for another owner's session carries only its id, name, status, owner and timestamps.
